id: title:Gilbert09:let v3 lock redis calls propagate activity cancellation

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and failure handling
review.reason: Adds asyncio and temporalio.exceptions imports, a _is_cancellation helper, and a cancellation check before Redis unavailability logging. This distinguishes Temporal activity cancellation from Redis failures, allowing warehouse ingestion to propagate cancellation rather than treating it as a Redis failure. This supports warehouse ingestion reliability and failure handling.
